title: Groomer Booked
description: No grooming appointments available this week
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Салон для животных. Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You are pet groomer. This week fully booked. Can do next Monday at 10am, or partner salon has opening Thursday. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User booked appointment for next week or at partner salon.
hints: Хочу записать собаку на стрижку (I want to book a haircut for my dog)
Когда есть свободное время? (When is there availability?)
Хорошо, запишите на понедельник (OK, book me for Monday)
